answerNotes.CURLING: Curling uses sliding stones and brooms, rather than skates and a puck.

answerNotes.BROOM: Sweeping can influence how far a stone travels and how much it curls.
answerNotes.END: An end is a round of play rather than the whole match.

answerNotes.BINDING: Bindings hold the foot while allowing movement appropriate to the design.

answerNotes.FRAME: Modern snowshoes can use molded designs instead of a separate frame.
answerNotes.STRAP: Straps are part of the attachment rather than a walking pole.

answerNotes.BASKET: The basket spreads the pole's support over more snow.
answerNotes.STRIDE: A stride combines coordinated movements rather than a downhill turn.

answerNotes.COAST: Coasting uses momentum and the hill's slope rather than a motor.
